catalog.summary: Multi-step form with validation per step.

patternStatus: No APG pattern names a wizard. Read on 2026-09-25: the WAI Multi-page Forms tutorial supplies the progress in the main heading, the ordered step indicator with its hidden current and completed text, the link back to completed steps that keeps what was typed, and the skippable optional step. The progress keeps the stepper family's own transcription and each step keeps the form family's.
reference: PatternFly Wizard, Clarity clr-wizard, SAP OpenUI5 sap.m.Wizard, Carbon for IBM Products CreateTearsheet, Angular CDK Stepper, Zag steps, Mantine Stepper, GOV.UK Question pages and Check answers
engine: @slotted/core/wizard for the flow's arithmetic and the snapshot; @slotted/core/steps under it for reachability; @slotted/core/form through the form family; @slotted/core/state for the three models

roles.root: none: the progress is the stepper, which declined a navigation landmark, and each step form is named by its own heading
roles.step form: the form family's form, aria-labelledby step-title
roles.error: the alert family, a section named by its title and live=off: focus moves to it, which is what announces it
roles.complete: group, aria-labelledby the consumer's heading inside it when there is one

anatomy.root: a div carrying data-ui=wizard, data-progress, data-scroll, and data-loading, data-invalid or data-complete for the submission cycle; the container named slotted-wizard
anatomy.layout: the grid of progress and main, one element in from the root so the container query on the root can change its tracks
anatomy.progress: the column or row holding the stepper; data-open while the compact progress is expanded
anatomy.progress-toggle: a button laid out only in the compact class: aria-expanded, aria-controls the stepper's list; holds progress-position, progress-track and a chevron; it does not repeat the step's name, which the heading under it says
anatomy.progress-position: messages.position for the current step, inside the toggle; the toggle's accessible name
anatomy.progress-track: aria-hidden: one progress-segment per step present, the whole flow at a glance where no column can hold the list
anatomy.progress-segment: one step: data-complete, data-current or data-invalid, the facts the stepper's markers carry
anatomy.main: the column of error, step and actions, or of complete
anatomy.error: a div around the alert family in the danger tone, rendered while error or a failed submission stands
anatomy.step: the div around the current step: header and form; aria-busy while a draft is restored
anatomy.step-title: an h2, h3 or h4 by level, tabindex=-1, the focus target on every step change; holds position, the step's label and optional
anatomy.position: messages.position inside the heading, on its own line above the label
anatomy.optional: the tag family reading messages.optional, inside the heading, on an optional step only
anatomy.step-description: the consumer's sentence under the heading; absent when none is given
anatomy.actions: the row under the step: actions-start and actions-end
anatomy.actions-start: the actions that leave the flow: cancel and save-draft, then draft-status
anatomy.actions-end: the actions that move it: skip, previous, then next or submit at the end edge
anatomy.cancel: a button, the button family's ghost variant: asks onCancel with dirty; closes nothing
anatomy.save-draft: a button, the button family's secondary variant: writes the snapshot; loading while the save is pending; rendered only when onSaveDraft or persistence is given
anatomy.draft-status: a polite status reading messages.saved, messages.saving or messages.draftFailed; empty until the first save
anatomy.skip: a button, ghost: on an optional step only; accepts the step with {} and moves on
anatomy.previous: a button, secondary: the previous step present; absent on the first
anatomy.next: a submit button, primary, form= the step form's id: on every step but the last; reads messages.return while a return point stands; loading while validate is pending
anatomy.submit: the same button on the last step, reading messages.submit; data-final; loading while onSubmit is pending
anatomy.edit: a button placed by the consumer, usually on a review step: goes to the named step and sets the return point; messages.edit plus the step's label, hidden, for its accessible name
anatomy.complete: the consumer's content after an accepted submission, in place of step and actions; tabindex=-1, the focus target
anatomy.skeleton: stands for the step form while an asynchronous restore is pending: one field family field whose label and control are skeletons; the step-header keeps its parts with skeleton lines for position and title; actions absent

wiring.form: next and submit carry form= the step form's id, so they submit it from outside it, as the platform allows
wiring.aria-labelledby: on the step form, naming step-title
wiring.aria-controls: on progress-toggle, naming the stepper list; on each stepper trigger, naming the step form
wiring.aria-busy: on the step while a draft is restored; on the step form while validate is pending, through the form family's loading

request.value: ChangeRequest<WizardValue>: Record<name, StepValues>, the accepted answers
request.equal: a request for a value equal to the current one is not emitted
request.cancel: onCancel({ dirty, source }): dirty is true while any step holds typed values that were not accepted, or accepted values that were not submitted
request.saveDraft: onSaveDraft(snapshot, request): reason pointer from the part, programmatic from the handle, submit from autosave
request.submitResult: onSubmit(values, request) returns void, a WizardFailure { message, step?, errors? }, or a promise of either; a rejected promise is a failure whose message is messages.submitFailed

rules.complete: a step is complete exactly when its name is in value; a value from a server declares completed steps without a second field
rules.drafts: typed values not yet accepted are held per step as drafts, not value; they reach the fields by the same way value does, and they are part of the snapshot
rules.advance: a submission of the step runs the form family's constraint validation, then the step's validate(values, { value, signal }); errors go to the step form; a promise sets next to loading; going back or jumping aborts it through the AbortSignal and a late answer does not advance
rules.back: previous and a jump backward keep the step's typed values as a draft without validating them
rules.jump: on a jump forward to a reachable step the current step is submitted first; the destination is the header chosen
rules.destination: decided after the consumer has rendered the list the accepted answer produces, so a step the answer opens is the next one; after a step is accepted: with a return point, the first incomplete step between the current step and the return point, otherwise the return point; without one, the next step present; on the last step, the submission
rules.restore: a restored value is announced in either mode and the draft's step is resolved after the consumer has rendered the list that value produces
rules.clamp: a requested step that is absent or unreachable becomes the first incomplete step, requested with the reason programmatic; only a requested step is clamped (a URL, a restore, a controlled step), never the current step because the list changed
rules.submit: onSubmit receives the accepted values of only the steps present at submission; with linear=false an incomplete step is requested first and the submission does not run
rules.failure: a failure shows in error and takes focus; with step the family requests that step and publishes errors to its form
rules.branching: the steps are the ones the consumer renders; the current step leaving the list requests the next present step, or the previous one; an absent step keeps its entry in value and is left out of the submission; a new name is a new step, incomplete and empty
rules.insertedBefore: a step that appears before the current one leaves the current step where it is; the next advance goes to the first incomplete step before its destination, and the submission does not run past it
rules.controlledAbsent: a controlled step that names an absent step renders the step the family requested, the way pagination renders the clamped page
rules.returnAbsent: a return point that leaves the list is dropped, and the advance goes to the next present step
rules.pendingRemoved: a step that leaves the list while its validate is pending aborts it; a late answer neither advances nor publishes errors
rules.uniqueNames: two steps with one name throw: they would share one answer
rules.liveConditions: a condition over value shows its step after the advance that accepted the answer; a live preview reads the consumer's own state
rules.countChanges: messages.position is recomputed and not announced; the next step's heading says the new position when it takes focus
rules.empty: no steps throws: a wizard with nothing to show is a consumer mistake a render would hide
rules.skip: skip accepts an optional step with {} in value
rules.url: the family never writes location; a router owns step through the controlled pair, and an unreachable step is clamped
rules.busy: while validate or onSubmit is pending the headers, previous, cancel and save-draft refuse, the way a loading control does not answer press

snapshot.version: the consumer's version of the flow; a snapshot with another version is not restored
snapshot.drafts: the typed answers not yet accepted, per step

persistence.sync: a synchronous load is read before the first render, so a reload paints the restored step at once
persistence.storage: storagePersistence({ key, storage, version }) over sessionStorage or localStorage; a File entry is omitted because Storage holds strings
persistence.version: a snapshot whose version differs is ignored and cleared
persistence.clear: an accepted submission and reset() clear it

focus.initial: the first render does not move focus
focus.step: every step change moves focus to step-title, which says the position and the step's name
focus.invalid: a refused submission of a step moves focus where the form family's errorFocus says
focus.failure: a failed submission moves focus to the alert in error
focus.complete: an accepted submission moves focus to complete
focus.escape: Escape inside the expanded compact progress closes it and returns focus to progress-toggle

waits.restore: an asynchronous load: the skeleton part after delay, held for minDuration, aria-busy on step, messages.restoring announced once
waits.validate: the next button's own loading; aria-busy on the step form
waits.submit: the submit button's own loading; data-loading on the root
waits.draft: the save-draft button's own loading, then draft-status

keyboard.effect: inside a text control of the step form: submits the step, the platform's implicit submission
keyboard.focus: step-title of the next step, or the form family's error focus

keyboard.effect: inside the expanded compact progress: closes it
the page's own order: progress, step, actions

reflow.below: the progress collapses behind progress-toggle and the two action groups stack
reflow.reason: 600px is the compact size class of docs/component-features.md §2.7, the edge under which a page surface changes its composition; the wizard is a page surface

modal.reason: Clarity opens its wizard as a modal and Carbon in a tearsheet. The layer is dialog's and drawer's; scroll=self makes main scroll and pins actions inside it.

subSteps.composition: a step with several sections composes section inside its form
subSteps.reason: PatternFly alone nests steps under a parent step.

documentTitle.reason: The WAI tutorial puts the progress in <title>, which the router owns; two owners of the title diverge.

timedAutosave.reason: A timer writes while the reader is typing and saves nothing the accepted step does not already save.

when.reason: UI5 and Carbon declare inclusion on the step; each framework already renders conditionally.

messagesReason: The words the family says come from the wizard catalog of the language in force, laid over by one messages input on the root. position takes the one-based index and the count as slots; saved takes the hour and minute the binding has already written with Intl.DateTimeFormat in the locale in force, so each language orders its own sentence around the time.

--slotted-wizard-progress-inline-size.reason: The column the vertical progress takes beside the step. Fourteen rem holds a marker, its gap and a two-word label at the default type size without a break; a longer label wraps.

literals.reflowBreakpoint: 600px is literal because CSS forbids a custom property in a container condition, which docs/token-foundation.md rule 4 records. It is the compact size class, and docs/component-features.md §2.7 names it.
